caption: Supplementary Fig. 18 | Changes in paired energy contrasts under the fixed supporting comparisons. The first two rows within each panel show the direct alternative-minus-main change for a 16-day input displacement and a 0–500 km region, respectively. Each change uses identical SID and relative-time support in the two configurations. The third row shows the conditional zero-speed/zero-intensity-difference estimate minus the raw contrast on the same covariate-complete sample. Points and horizontal limits reproduce the saved changes and pointwise 95% intervals; the conditional model retains all attempted draws and any failure status in Tables S7h,i. Successful-refit intervals, where applicable, remain conditional on target-supported refits. Missing targets are labelled unavailable rather than plotted at zero. These comparisons quantify method and target dependence; interval overlap with zero does not establish equivalence. Tables S7e,f,g retain the fixed input, radius and pre-departure land-contact comparisons.
